items.name: Veihaukeskjegg
botanicalRequirements: Yellow, all-ligulate flower heads, several to numerous on an upright branching plant
Basal lanceolate or lobed leaves and much smaller narrow clasping upper stem leaves
Two rows of involucral bracts, with short outer awl-shaped bracts and hairy longer inner bracts
Narrow flower stems, buds and a realistic taproot or basal stem; recognizably distinct from Crepis capillaris
items.observations: Botanical watercolor illustration of Veihaukeskjegg with branching stems bearing several bright yellow all-ligulate composite heads, green hairy involucres, narrow sessile stem leaves, toothed and lobed basal leaves, and the taproot. Inspected on a black background.
items.limitations: Stylized pedagogical drawing, not a photograph or voucher specimen; hair and involucre details are simplified. Not intended to serve as a definitive identification key.
